text:
Maya: quick syncthinking we should add a tiny admission sidecar to normalize Dedicated pool signals (SLO/cost/burst) so operator logic stays thin.

Chris: yes. we keep duplicating heuristics. minimal API?

Maya: tenant intent + util snapshot + burst tokens in, canonical admit proto out (accept, grant_tokens, recommended_model, revision).

Jon: caching is critical for latency. short in-memory TTL for bursts + soft warmup cache. operator can use grant_tokens to avoid per-request calls.

Sara: private deployments can't phone home. support disconnected mode with signed policy bundles.

Chris: rollout sketch? pilot hosted -> operator sidecar -> stress test bursts -> dashboards. metrics: admit latency, cache hit, token drift.

Maya: action items: (1) i'll draft RFC + proto fragment (EOW), (2) sara will start operator client next week, (3) chris perf harness.

Jon: testcases: sustained high util with tiny bursts, policy flip from cost->latency, disconnected bundle expiry.

Sara: sounds good. i'll own the operator PR.

Maya: thanks all.
